title: Vitals grid shows a clipped sliver beside the names: on desktop when it opens, on a phone after a swipe to the end
evidence: From D2 (the phone fade after H79; first written as H102 on PR 1712, which was dropped; H102 is now PR 1714's). Desktop: at 1440 in real WebKit, with 13 saved weights, the vitals grid opens at scrollLeft 678 of 678: Trend is sticky at the right (styles.css .bt-timeline-scroll .bt-cell-trend), New 818-900, Trend 900-954. The left-most visible date column sits partly under the sticky name column, so only its "ys / dia" tail shows. H79 snaps whole columns only where Trend scrolls (widget-src/src/lib/useValuePage.ts:85-95). Phone: at 390, after a swipe to the end, a "lia" sliver (the tail of an older column's "sys / dia") shows beside the name column. H79's snap runs only when the grid is shown; a swipe ends at max scrollLeft (scrollWidth - clientWidth), which is not a whole column. Shot: d2-fade-390-end.png in session 701729d1's scratchpad. Remedy: on desktop, snap the left edge to a whole column with the sticky Trend's width taken out of max, so New stays clear of Trend; on a phone, make the scroll end on a whole column too. (H105)
